verdict.rationale: Postman's mock servers simulate a real API that is always available for requests, and the Postman CLI can start local mock servers and run disruption simulations against them, so testing can happen without hitting production. Environments allow switching variable sets, which a community user confirms they rely on for testing across environments. Agent Mode and the CLI's coding-agent context let AI workflows send requests and run these tests. Missing for 10: explicit docs on isolating agents or Agent Mode to non-production environments or credentials, in-depth evidence on environment management beyond a link title, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven sandbox testing.
